GAUGE adaptive-canopy mark, redrawn as native SVG from the author's approved reference.
Lettering uses Inter Bold outlines and requires no installed fonts.
Light: blue #0072B2, sky blue #56B4E9, orange #E69F00, ink #111111.
Dark: blue #75C7EE, sky blue #B4DFF4, orange #F4B942, ink #F8FAFC.
Logo and icon files have transparent backgrounds. Favicon SVGs omit the fine lower branches.
Regenerate SVGs with python scripts/generate_logo.py. Font attribution is in Inter-LICENSE.txt.
